sourceState: Local uncommitted implementation; prior measurement-point UI edits preserved.

userReport.originalAlert: Automatic measurement points unavailable; garment kind not recognized.

changes: Validated live frame owns full-resolution sRGB CGImage, matching raw sceneDepth, intrinsics, original orientation, timestamp, points, mask, kind and model version.
Runtime handoff validates accepted readiness, current session/epoch/orientation, source age, camera liveness, current tracking/depth and movement, then consumes the frame once.
One-slot policy adds a timestamp high-water mark within the current session/epoch; adapter independently validates current epoch and strictly newer callbacks.
JPEG encoding runs once for the consumed owned image; no ARFrame or pooled camera buffer crosses the model await.
Valid prepared frame skips repeated inference while retaining workflow frame/origin/model/definition and engine validation.
Absent or expired prepared frame falls back to fresh RGB/depth capture and normalized sRGB inference; no other frame points are borrowed.
Shutter can operate before semantic recognition when camera, models, depth and tracking are ready. Recognition cue still requires existing verified evidence.
Failure explanations separate classification, missing points, missing foreground, foreground mismatch and unverified garment structure.
Model weights, pose schemas, selection thresholds and persistent CaptureSnapshot schema unchanged.

localRGBRegression.scope: macOS supplied classifier/pose/Vision on same original CGImage and lossless PNG; no physical camera/depth/centimetres.

limitations: No actual failing long-sleeved iPhone photo was provided; its exact rejection stage remains unknown.
No physical iPhone test, wall-clock capture latency benchmark or tape-measure centimetre comparison performed.
UI fixtures use explicitly synthetic geometry and depth; they do not demonstrate ML or LiDAR accuracy.
Local model photos may overlap training data and are not a held-out generalization dataset.
Same-CGImage/lossless-PNG model checks do not prove JPEG equivalence or actual ARKit ticket handoff.
Prepared captures use raw sceneDepth; optional smoothed-depth comparison and fresh-capture selection diagnostics are absent for that path.
Prepared photo is the last eligible validated frame, up to the existing two-second source-age limit, rather than a newly chosen frame after the shutter.
Full-raster copies and JPEG encoding are bounded in ownership but peak memory and sustained frame times require physical-device profiling.
